Plug in the coefficients and simplify.

To find stationary points, first take the derivative f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are candidates for stationary points. Plug each x-value back into f(x) to find the corresponding y-values. Analyze the second derivative to determine if each point is a local minimum, maximum, or inflection point.
